game_title: Letter Lock – Ice Cave Shelter Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter, a shelter in an ice cave: the mountaineer must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the flag pole.
theme: Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter: a shelter in an ice cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Cave Shelter, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the flag pole. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the lock_letters value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the flag pole using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The flag pole reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the flag pole is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Letter Lock' (Week 8 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ice Cave Shelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_letters changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The flag pole reached with actions_used <= 21.
